import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        List<Integer> list = new ArrayList<>(n);
        int sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int x = scanner.nextInt();
            list.add(x);
            sum += x;
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
    }
}
